_meta.source: Lenovo XCC REST API guide + Lenovo Press LP1477 + public real-device dumps (see sources)
_meta.firmware_version: latest XCC/UEFI for SR630/SR650/SD530/SR630 V2 NOT determined. Reference snapshots: SR670 V2 XCC TGBT42S 2.83 (2023-07-05) / UEFI U8E122J; docs example SR650 UEFI CDI340M
_meta.status: partial (attribute NAMES for Whitley from a real SR670 V2 dump; Purley (SR630/SR650/SD530) only tuning subset + doc examples; no Lenovo registry JSON available publicly)

field_semantics.type: null unless the registry entry was published (docs) - type_hint is inferred from the JSON value type of real dumps
field_semantics.allowed_values: Redfish ValueName list; only from published registry entries in docs
field_semantics.allowed_values_display: UI/display choices from Lenovo Press tuning guide; Redfish spelling replaces space/dash/slash with underscore (e.g. "I/O sensitive" -> I_OSensitive) - see observed values
field_semantics.default: only from docs registry; default_display from tuning guide
field_semantics.verification: verified = attribute name seen in >=2 independent sources or a published registry entry; otherwise unverified

_meta.proxy_warning: SR670 V2 is NOT a user model. It shares the Whitley platform + XCC generation with SR630 V2, but slot/NVMe-bay/PCIe-slot attributes (DevicesandIOPorts_*_SlotN, EnableDisableAdapterOptionROMSupport_SlotN, *_NVMeBayN) and core-count dependent attributes (Processors_ProcessorsXtoYcoresactive) differ per chassis/CPU. Real SR630 V2 attribute set must be dumped from the device.

uris.bios_settings_note: Lenovo has NO /Bios/Settings; the @Redfish.Settings.SettingsObject of Bios points to /Bios/Pending (SupportedApplyTimes: OnReset)
uris.registries_collection: /redfish/v1/Registries (from Lenovo sample scripts: member whose @odata.id contains the Bios.AttributeRegistry name)
uris.patch_example: PATCH /redfish/v1/Systems/1/Bios/Pending {"Attributes": {"<Name>": "<Value>"}} -> 200 RebootRequired; applied on next host reset

doc_xcc_rest.note: attribute list elided ("…") in doc; only examples

lp1477.note: tuning subset only (33 settings extracted by script from PDF text; extraction may omit a value at page breaks)

dump_sr670v2.note: Bios and Bios/Pending identical (348 attrs). Whitley platform = same as SR630 V2. Proxy only (different chassis/slots).

dump_unknown2022.note: platform/XCC generation not stated in the repo; treated as XCC1-era Intel (unverified)

sapcc_sr650.note: settings that operators apply; value style evidence

lenovo_py_redfish.note: URI flow only (Bios -> @Redfish.Settings.SettingsObject = Pending; registry via Registries)

attribute_count_note: union of names from all sources (not the complete registry of any single model); device-specific NIC/RAID attributes listed separately as patterns
